label: Doctor's tip · Eggs
head: What's really
in an egg?
name: Dr. Neal Barnard
end_cta: Find Dr. Neal Barnard on|Vegans Explore

captions.text: Keep in mind, when a chicken lays an egg,
in that egg is everything it takes to make a chick.
While that egg is incubating, the little chicken inside
isn't ordering out for takeout food.
Everything it takes to make a beak, and eyes, and a liver, and feet
Chicken eggs are among the very highest sources of cholesterol.
About half the cholesterol in the foods you eat goes into your bloodstream,
and when it goes in, it increases your risk of heart problems.
So I would take that egg and set it aside.
I would leave it alone. You don't need that.
